plan: Since this is the only round, I should aim to maximize my profit based on my value of $22. To win, I should bid slightly above the expected average bid of other rational bidders. Assuming they bid around half their value due to uncertainty, I estimate an average bid of around $12. To ensure a win while maintaining profit, I will bid slightly above this, at $13.
